deviations.change: Use real loopback TCP/QUIC, explicit mocks and owned dynamic HTTP fixtures for local gates; provide exact external procedures. Keep physical/platform/review/idle results UNVERIFIED and missing live-provider scenarios SKIPPED_ENVIRONMENT.

deviations.approval_status: Explicitly authorized by brief sections 32 and 34. No physical success or release decision is inferred.
deviations.rollback: External runs add new separate evidence bundles; never overwrite local, failed or skipped evidence to relabel it.
